input: Laminate and frame the kids' crayon drawings

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The number of drawings determines how much laminating material, how many frames, and how much time and effort the whole project requires.
Knowing how many kids and their ages helps determine the variety of drawing sizes and whether the project is a gift or purely for home display.
Where the framed pieces will hang (bedroom, hallway, living room, office) shapes decisions about frame style, quantity, and arrangement.
A set budget determines whether to DIY laminate and buy off-the-shelf frames, use a professional print shop, or invest in custom framing.
The desired aesthetic — matching frames vs. eclectic, black-and-white vs. coloured mats — directly drives which frames and materials to buy.
Whether the user plans to DIY with a home laminator vs. using a print/copy shop changes the tools, steps, and time needed in the plan.
Understanding what 'done well' looks like — a polished gallery wall, a keepsake book, a surprise gift — ensures the plan targets the right end result.
